note: Gate C span frontier on methane's real traces. 24 state-seeds (8 seeds x 3 states). 'false' = gate fires on the UNMODIFIED trace (no planted deficit); 'det50' = fires on a planted 50 % deficit. Preregistered span is 0.20.
rule_of_three_upper_bound_on_false_rate: 0/24 bounds the false-positive rate at <= 12 % (95 %), NOT at zero
caveat: the false-positive column is measured on a system with no deficit and methane's own autocorrelation; it does not transfer to a system with slower orthogonal relaxation
